name: Idli
note: 2:1 parboiled rice and urad dal batter; steamed; about 18 idlis of 40 g; salt not counted

name: Plain dosa
note: Rice and urad dal batter; about 10 dosas of 50 g with 2.5 g oil each

name: Upma
note: Sooji roasted then cooked in about 250 ml water; curry leaves left out (a gap; negligible weight)

name: Rasam
note: Thin tamarind-tomato soup with a little toor dal; mostly water so the cooked weight is about 4x the raw weight

name: Kadhi
note: Curd and besan simmered with about 300 ml water; oil tadka

name: Keema
note: USDA goat is lean (109 kcal raw); keema mince is often fattier so real values may be higher

name: Kheer
note: Whole milk simmered with rice until reduced to about 700 g

name: Khoa (mawa)
note: Whole milk boiled down to about 18 % of its weight (khoa has about 25-35 % moisture); USDA cow milk is 3.25 % fat so khoa from buffalo or full-cream milk is richer (about 420 kcal)

name: Milk barfi
note: Plain barfi: whole milk boiled down to khoa plus sugar

name: Besan ladoo
note: Besan roasted in ghee; sugar added; a little moisture lost while roasting

name: Papad (roasted)
note: Urad dal papad roasted; fried papad absorbs oil so log oil separately
